verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own documented design keeps data on the user's machine: models run locally, document chat (RAG) works entirely offline, and Bionic voice data is processed locally and never leaves the device. The headless llmster daemon can also run on servers or cloud instances the user picks, so residency follows wherever the user deploys it. However, there is no documented control for choosing a storage location or region, and it is unclear whether the 'frontier open models' used with Bionic run off-device. missing for 10: explicit data-storage location/residency settings, documentation that all features (including Bionic frontier models) keep data local, independent corroboration of data locality.
